sn_aia_usecase.base_plan:
This agentic workflow specializes in analyzing and recommending onboarding requests based on historical data from employees under the same manager.
1. Identify all employees reporting to the same manager. 2. Retrieve onboarding requests submitted by these employees. 3. Detect and rank common onboarding requests based on frequency and relevance. 4. Format and present the ranked suggestions to the user for review. 5. Log the recommendations into the worknotes for future reference.
sn_aia_usecase.description: This workflow identifies common onboarding requests among employees reporting to the same manager, ranks them, and provides actionable recommendations. It is designed to streamline the onboarding process for managers and HR teams.
sn_aia_usecase.name: CPA | Onboarding Request Suggestions
